title: Script prototype local-name lookup
summary: Recover VA 0x4f4c40: scan 12-byte local records from prototype +0x18, signed count at +0x38; select the one-based ordinal among start <= position < end, stop at the first start > position, and return name-object address +16. No writes. Caller at 0x4866de establishes ECX prototype, EDX ordinal, caller-popped stack position. The member interface uses a normal portable ABI; test-only regparm adapter models the original custom ABI.
test_description: Direct original-reference differential checks for negative/zero counts with null table, overlapping intervals, all interval boundaries, signed position extremes, ordinal zero/negative-bit-patterns/large values, truncated tables, empty/reversed intervals, unsorted early stop, null and wrapping name addresses. Explicit expected cases verify ordinal selection. Compare complete prototype, records and string fixtures for no writes; install test FS and check its head after every original call.
known_limits: Only assigned leaf is recovered; other prototype fields and string header contents remain opaque.
Original binary layout assertions apply to 32-bit targets; a 64-bit port uses native pointers and adjusted structure layout.
Invalid prototype/table memory and oversized counts requiring inaccessible records remain caller errors; no validation is invented.
Sampled differential behavior is not byte matching or whole-game recovery.
